t: You're at Knightsbridge tube station, in the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. It's on the Piccadilly line, between South Kensington and Hyde Park Corner, in fare zone 1. The architect Leslie Green designed it. He is best known for the stations he produced for the Underground in the 1900s, with their oxblood red glazed faïence blocks, pillars, semi-circular windows on the first floor, and patterned tiled interiors in the Modern Style.
